40: func GetObjects[CT, T kubeinterfaces.ObjectInterface](
41: 	ctx context.Context,
42: 	controller metav1.Object,
43: 	controllerGVK schema.GroupVersionKind,
44: 	selector labels.Selector,
45: 	control ControlleeManagerGetObjectsInterface[CT, T],
46: ) (map[string]T, error) {
47: 	// List all objects to find even those that no longer match our selector.
48: 	// They will be orphaned in ClaimObjects().
49: 	objects, err := control.ListObjects(labels.Everything())
50: 	if err != nil {
51: 		return nil, err
52: 	}
53: 	return controllertools.NewControllerRefManager[T](
54: 		ctx,
55: 		controller,
56: 		controllerGVK,
57: 		selector,
58: 		controllertools.ControllerRefManagerControlFuncsConverter[CT, T]{
59: 			GetControllerUncachedFunc: func(ctx context.Context, name string, opts metav1.GetOptions) (CT, error) {
60: 				return control.GetControllerUncached(ctx, name, opts)
61: 			},
62: 			PatchObjectFunc: func(ctx context.Context, name string, pt types.PatchType, data []byte, opts metav1.PatchOptions, subresources ...string) (T, error) {
63: 				return control.PatchObject(ctx, name, pt, data, opts, subresources...)
64: 			},
65: 		}.Convert(),
66: 	).ClaimObjects(objects)
67: }
